laws.title: Semantic equality is not representational equality
laws.summary: Equivalent logical inputs must not diverge because of incidental representation.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Canonical proof projections normalize non-security-bearing variance while preserving security-bearing differences.

laws.title: Observed operation result is not authoritative state
laws.summary: A client result and the authoritative post-state may disagree.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Repository producers reconcile authoritative state and use bounded idempotent convergence rather than trusting one command result.

laws.title: Final disposition is not sufficient evidence
laws.summary: A final allow, deny, pass, or fail can hide materially different causes.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Proof and audit retain owner, operation, policy, evidence, and failure-class context behind terminal projections.

laws.title: Identity authenticates the actor; request binding authenticates the act
laws.summary: A valid actor identity does not by itself authorize an exact action.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Supported authority paths bind authenticated identity to policy-scoped operations and targets.

laws.title: Credential issuance requires declared intent
laws.summary: Identity existence does not establish eligibility for every credential path.
laws.current_v1_invariant: SPIRE registration and service-account selectors bound issuance, but V1 does not separately prove declared credential-consumer intent.

laws.title: Consumer convergence is stronger than producer convergence
laws.summary: A distributed security property exists at its load-bearing consumers, not merely its producer.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Qualification follows SPIRE trust through Istio and Envoy and exercises policy and network behavior at consumers.

laws.title: Determinism includes the evaluator
laws.summary: Policy source alone does not identify the complete decision function.
laws.current_v1_invariant: V1 binds source and semantic proof projections but does not claim universal evaluator-version provenance for every decision.

laws.title: Authority provenance is part of provenance
laws.summary: A valid signature is not by itself proof of legitimate signing authority.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Artifact digests, signer trust, key registry, source binding, and verification results remain distinct evidence.

laws.title: Security decisions require causal context
laws.summary: A deterministic decision over incomplete relationships can be reproducibly wrong.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Evidence contracts and the system model preserve target, identity, policy, dependency, and source relationships needed by bounded claims.

laws.title: Valid transitions do not imply a valid transaction
laws.summary: Individually admissible edges can form a forbidden causal sequence.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Operation Contracts bind preconditions, execution, completion, guarantees, evidence, and certification without claiming ACID semantics.

laws.title: Semantic authority must be consumed durably
laws.summary: Fresh tokens do not prevent repeated consumption of the same semantic authority.
laws.current_v1_invariant: V1 makes no distributed one-use semantic-authority claim.
laws.upstream_failure_class: local replay resistance mistaken for durable consumption

laws.title: Idempotency belongs at the effect boundary
laws.summary: Ambiguous success must reconcile authoritative effect state before repetition.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Supported convergence producers re-observe owned state before bounded retries; V1 has no general transaction claim.

laws.title: Trust semantics cannot be recovered by reinterpretation
laws.summary: Malformed declared trust evidence must fail rather than become another trust type.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Trust, signature, and identity parsing fail closed without claimant-selected fallback authority.

laws.title: Lifecycle validity is part of identity
laws.summary: Historical authentication does not grant current workload authority.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Authority defaults UNCLAIMED and requires a currently validated SPIRE identity; no synthetic fallback grants authority.
laws.upstream_failure_class: historical credential treated as current authority

laws.title: Observability is not automatically proof
laws.summary: Telemetry can support only claims bounded by its capture, loss, ordering, and tamper semantics.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Metrics, logs, and traces are corroborative unless a bounded verifier establishes their capture contract; no lossy source alone proves completeness.
laws.upstream_failure_class: telemetry presence treated as complete proof

laws.title: Preparation proves historical admissibility, not current committability
laws.summary: Mutable predicates may invalidate a prepared action before commit.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Reviewed V1 trust and publication flows re-evaluate load-bearing current state before activation.

laws.title: Mandatory mediation must be proven
laws.summary: Configured routing does not establish that protected effects cannot bypass mediation.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Admission, ingress, east-west, registry, and identity boundaries include negative bypass specimens on supported paths.

laws.title: Verifier complexity is part of the trust boundary
laws.summary: Syntactically valid evidence may impose disproportionate verification work.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Individual verifiers use bounded inputs and timeouts, but V1 makes no universal structural-budget claim.

laws.title: Consumed context is evidence
laws.summary: Available shared state does not prove that a decision consumed that state.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Bounded decisions retain source, digest, policy, or operation context where the claim depends on it.
laws.upstream_failure_class: available context mistaken for consumed context

laws.title: Security scope must be explicit
laws.summary: Absent or ambiguous namespace coordinates must not define security scope.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Policy, RBAC, identity, and evidence checks bind explicit namespace and cluster scope.
laws.current_owner: namespace contract, RBAC, and policy owners

laws.title: Evidence status is not evidence
laws.summary: Verified or certified labels must not collapse distinct bounded claims.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Proof guarantees, integrity, source binding, audit, and certification remain separate claim surfaces.

laws.title: Displayed metadata is not a cryptographically bound claim
laws.summary: Displayed timestamps and labels are not signed unless the evidence commits them.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Documentation separates operational metadata from signed artifacts and source/run binding.
laws.upstream_failure_class: display projection mistaken for cryptographic commitment

laws.title: Every derived view must be bound to its source state
laws.summary: A conclusion must not silently combine incompatible generations as one snapshot.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Source SHA, object UID, owner references, digests, and imageID bind load-bearing projections where supported claims require them.

laws.title: Required security must not degrade implicitly
laws.summary: Unavailable required security is not equivalent to weaker security.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Missing identity, policy, trust, signer, or verifier state blocks protected effects and final PASS.
laws.current_owner: identity, policy, supply-chain, and proof owners

laws.title: Authorizer and effect handler must share one canonical action
laws.summary: Authorization must describe the same semantic action that execution performs.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Reviewed V1 HTTP, image, policy, and target boundaries use consistent normalized action fields; no mismatch was found.

laws.title: Constitutional authority must precede governed state
laws.summary: Mutable governed state cannot be the sole authority protecting itself.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Human authorization, clean source, pinned inputs, host trust, and signing authority precede mutable Kubernetes state.

laws.title: Revocation completes at the relying party
laws.summary: Source-of-truth retirement is incomplete until required consumers reject predecessor authority.
laws.current_v1_invariant: V1 proves successor publication, consumer acceptance, and current-lineage convergence, not universal retired-root rejection.

laws.title: Placement is not identity
laws.summary: Node or host placement does not uniquely identify a runtime actor.
laws.current_v1_invariant: V1 claims SPIFFE workload/service identity and does not equate placement with unique instance authority.

laws.title: Capability absence is stronger than denied capability
laws.summary: Removing an unnecessary privileged surface is stronger than relying on denial policy.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Important surfaces are default-deny or unreachable, but V1 makes no universal capability-minimality claim.
laws.current_owner: RBAC, workload security context, and support boundary owners

laws.title: Event ordering must be explicit
laws.summary: Natural datastore order is not an authoritative sequence contract.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Load-bearing audit, lifecycle, and proof sequences use explicit ordering keys and tie-break semantics.

laws.title: Replay protection is only as global as durable consumption state
laws.summary: A replica-local replay cache does not prove global one-use authority.
laws.current_v1_invariant: V1 does not claim distributed one-use semantic authority or independent semantic replay.

laws.title: A request cannot define its own trust context
laws.summary: Audience, issuer, trust domain, signer, and verifier expectations require independent configuration.
laws.current_v1_invariant: SPIFFE trust, XFCC, registry signer policy, and authority defaults derive from trusted policy rather than claimant headers.
laws.current_owner: identity, ingress, and supply-chain trust owners

laws.title: Transport location, content identity, and signer authority are different claims
laws.summary: Registry or mirror location must not redefine artifact identity or signer policy.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Canonical inventory, digest pins, Cosign verification, and runtime imageID reconciliation remain independent of transport location.
laws.current_owner: canonical image inventory and supply-chain verifiers
laws.upstream_failure_class: transport location conflated with content or signer

laws.title: Declared privilege is not evidence of necessity
laws.summary: Granted permissions do not prove that a workload requires them.
laws.current_v1_invariant: V1 proves bounded denial and least-scope contracts where declared, but does not claim universal privilege necessity.
laws.upstream_failure_class: granted privilege treated as necessary privilege

laws.title: Security silence is not success
laws.summary: All completed checks passing is insufficient when a mandatory check is missing or undecided.
laws.current_v1_invariant: Required phase and guarantee coverage must be complete; FAIL, BLOCKED, and NOT_EVALUATED prevent final PASS.
